user._instructions: Pixel padding for each side and radius for each corner. Values are independent by role. Surface profiles in this chat.json override chat_common. Missing, null or invalid padding uses CSS initial (no padding); corner defaults remain built-in; radius_px is an optional per-role all-corners fallback. line_height is a font-size multiplier or explicit CSS length; its default is 1.5 for either role. border and box_shadow accept CSS values; missing or null means no effect. Both are independent by role. radius_px or any radius_*_px may be auto: half a single text line plus vertical padding and borders; numeric corners override it independently.
